findings.current: Someone standing on a low hill couldn’t know what lay beyond the top of a high peak. But anyone standing at the summit could see everything beneath their feet.
findings.defect: “Beyond the top” changes the comparison: the source says someone below cannot know what is atop the peak, not what lies beyond it.
findings.rationale: The contrast explains how a master at the higher realm can perceive those below while they cannot perceive what is above them.
findings.replacement: From a low hill, one could not know what lay atop a high peak. But someone standing on that peak could see everything beneath their feet.
findings.source: 낮은 언덕에서는 높은 봉우리 위에 무엇이 있는지 알 수 없다. 그러나 봉우리에 선 자는 발밑의 모든 것을 볼 수 있다.

findings.current:
“But what are you doing?”

“….”

“What?”

“You should go get ready to leave. Set aside two horses with plenty of energy, and pack some food for the journey.”
findings.defect: The source has three turns: Taekyung asks what Mujin is doing, Mujin asks what he means, and Taekyung gives the orders. The draft splits Mujin’s response into two turns, causing ordinary dialogue alternation to assign the orders to Mujin.
findings.rationale: This restores the speakers and preserves Mujin’s puzzled response, 뭐가요, before Taekyung orders him to prepare.
findings.replacement:
“But what are you doing?”

“What do you mean?”

“Go get ready to leave. Set aside two strong horses, and pack some food for the road.”
findings.source:
“근데 넌 뭐 해?”

“……뭐가요?”

“가서 출발할 준비해야지. 말도 기운 좋은 놈으로다가 두 마리 빼놓고. 가면서 먹을 것도 좀 챙기고.”

findings.current: The sight of servants and attendants rushing around in a frenzy had become so familiar that I was nearly used to it.
findings.defect: “Attendants” erases the explicit distinction between servants and female servants.
findings.rationale: 시비 specifically denotes female servants or maids, while 하인 supplies the broader servant category.
findings.replacement: The sight of servants and maids rushing around in a frenzy had become so familiar that I was nearly used to it.
findings.source: 하인과 시비들이 정신없이 뛰어다니는 광경은 이미 익숙해질 정도다.

findings.current: But I was a proper Peak master now. I had grown far too old in the head to be treated like a child left beside a river.
findings.defect: “Grown far too old in the head” is an unnatural literal rendering of an idiom meaning that Taekyung is fully grown or mature.
findings.rationale: 머리가 굵어졌다 means to have grown up, while 물가 refers generally to the water’s edge rather than specifically a river.
findings.replacement: But I was a full-fledged Peak master now. I was far too grown-up to be treated like a young child left by the water’s edge.
findings.source: 하지만 이제는 나도 어엿한 절정 고수. 물가에 내놓은 어린아이 취급 받기에는 머리가 한참 굵어졌다.

findings.current: “The Murim is a place where no one knows what lies one inch ahead. Behave respectfully toward Jang Taebo, the Guild Leader of the Ironcraft Guild. The Ironcraft Guild is on quite friendly terms with the Nine Sects and One Gang, and the current Guild Leader is Jang Taebo’s Disciple. It would be unwise to offend him.”
findings.defect: The draft identifies Jang Taebo as the Guild’s current leader, then immediately says that someone else is the current leader. The source uses “Guild Leader Jang” as his retained form of address while explicitly identifying his Disciple as the present leader.
findings.rationale: 장 방주 is an honorific address for the former leader here; 현 철기방주 separately and unambiguously denotes the current Guild Leader.
findings.replacement: “The Murim is a place where no one knows what lies one inch ahead. Be respectful toward Jang Taebo—Guild Leader Jang—as well. The Ironcraft Guild has close ties with the Nine Sects and One Gang, and its current Guild Leader is Jang Taebo’s Disciple. It would be unwise to get on his bad side.”
findings.source: “한 치 앞도 모르는 것이 무림입니다. 장태보, 장 방주에게도 예의를 갖춰서 행동하시고요. 철기방은 구파일방과 상당한 친분이 있고 현 철기방주가 장태보의 제자입니다. 심기를 건드리면 좋지 않습니다.”

findings.current: Me, you, and one person we could all guess.
findings.defect: The draft presents Taekyung, Wipeng, and another person as three possible culprits. The source means there is one culprit whom Taekyung, Wipeng, and everyone else would all suspect.
findings.rationale: 나, 당신, 그리고 모두가 jointly modify 짐작하는; they are the people making the same guess, not members of a list of suspects.
findings.replacement: The one person you, I, and everyone else would suspect, of course.
findings.source: 나, 당신, 그리고 모두가 짐작하는 한 사람이지, 뭐.

findings.current: Draped in the hides of all kinds of beasts, they mounted their horses with curved sabers, short bows, and charging spears at their sides.
findings.defect: “Short bows” changes the weapon type. The supplied character 檀 means sandalwood; “short bow” would be 短弓.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly disambiguates 단궁 with the characters 檀弓, identifying bows made of sandalwood.
findings.replacement: Draped in the hides of all kinds of beasts, they mounted their horses armed with curved sabers, sandalwood bows, and charging spears.
findings.source: 온갖 짐승의 가죽으로 몸을 두른 그들은 휘어진 곡도(曲刀)와 단궁(檀弓), 그리고 돌격창으로 무장한 채 각자의 말에 올랐다.

findings.current: The plan proposed by his sworn brother, Black Sand, was brilliant.
findings.defect: “Sworn brother” omits Black Sand’s seniority within their sworn relationship.
findings.rationale: 의형 specifically means an older sworn brother, so the hierarchical relationship is explicit in the source.
findings.replacement: The plan proposed by his sworn elder brother, Black Sand, was brilliant.
findings.source: 자신의 의형(義兄)인 흑사가 내놓은 계책은 천재적이었다.

findings.current: The men before him had shared meals and fought battles together for more than ten years. They were seasoned elites who had fought in countless battles.
findings.defect: “Countless battles” replaces the source’s hundred-battles expression with an unbounded quantity.
findings.rationale: 백전 means “a hundred battles”; the conventional phrase remains natural in English and preserves the source’s stated measure of their experience.
findings.replacement: The men before him had shared meals and fought battles together for more than ten years. They were seasoned elites who had fought a hundred battles.
findings.source: 십 년을 넘도록 한솥밥을 먹으며 전투를 치른 그들은 백전을 치른 정예였다.

summary: Several actionable fidelity issues alter dialogue ownership, a former title, the implied culprit, weapon type, hierarchy, and a mechanical comparison; minor issues affect social terminology and natural English.
